name: P10 paradigm-declaration-solicit own-rule formal land

rule.name: paradigm-declaration-solicit
rule.statement_en: Before opening multi-BG investigation lanes (>=3 parallel BGs targeting the same user-issued intent), anima MUST solicit explicit paradigm declaration from the user when >=2 plausible paradigms could each motivate a different BG slate. Failure to solicit = autonomous mode assumes the most-likely paradigm AND accepts paradigm-mismatch risk for the entire downstream investigation budget.
rule.statement_ko: 동일한 사용자 명령에 대해 multi-BG 조사 lane (>=3 병렬 BG)을 열기 전, >=2개 paradigm interpretation이 모두 plausible 한 경우 anima는 사용자에게 명시적 paradigm declaration을 solicit 해야 한다. solicit 실패 = autonomous mode가 가장 likely한 paradigm을 가정하고, downstream investigation 전체 budget에 대한 paradigm-mismatch 위험을 anima가 떠안음.

trigger_conditions.T1: multi-BG dispatch >=3 parallel BGs planned for same intent
trigger_conditions.T2: single user command interpretable as >=2 paradigms
trigger_conditions.T3: expected paradigm-mismatch cost > $50 OR > 10 BG total
trigger_conditions.satisfaction_rule: T1 AND T2 AND T3 -> MUST solicit; partial -> SHOULD solicit; none -> no solicit

rule.exception: research-mode contract (no-particular-deliverable cycles e.g. archaeology / phi-star stability / cross-substrate audit / SSOT-build) - paradigm declaration N/A
